title: Self-Discovering Interpretable Diffusion Latent Directions for Responsible Text-to-Image Generation
reasoning: The paper identifies and benchmarks 'ethical-related latent vectors' to ensure fairness (reducing gender and racial bias) and safety (preventing inappropriate content) in generative models. It includes evaluations on established fairness/safety benchmarks and creates its own 'Responsible Text-enhancing Benchmark' to evaluate the adherence of models to ethical constraints.
